text:
In crates/athena-core/src/verify.rs, where a behavior criterion's cited command is not counted as seen (around lines 573-603), change the D43 finding's evidence so it says why. If the command matches a recorded check on the candidate tree that ran and failed or did not finish, the evidence must say that it ran in check <name> and failed (or did not finish). Use "not seen running" only for commands with no matching record. Keep the finding Major and the criterion unmet. Do not change any other D43 rule. Add unit tests for three cases: a failed matching record, an unfinished one with no exit code, and a truly unseen command. Each test asserts the evidence text. Update any test or prompt that pins the old text, and add a CHANGELOG.md entry. Acceptance: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test pass.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: The D43 finding says a cited command was "not seen running" when it ran and failed, so failure reviews blame missing command evidence
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass
